title: Signatures of Steerability in Activation Space of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.14151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Steering language models using a set of contrastive representations has been a canonical and computationally efficient method for controlling model behavior. Despite this success in controlling certain model behaviors, the effectiveness of activation steering varies markedly across concepts; the generalization properties of steering vectors are often considered a function of the dataset used to construct them. We make this dataset-dependence claim more rigorous and show that simple separation metrics strongly correlate with the downstream steerability of language models across diverse settings, even after controlling for layers and dataset effects. translated_title: 语言模型激活空间中可控性的特征标识
translated_abstract: 使用一组对比表征来引导语言模型一直是控制模型行为的经典且计算高效的方法。尽管在控制某些模型行为方面取得了成功，但激活引导的有效性在不同概念之间差异显著；引导向量的泛化特性通常被认为是用于构建它们的数据集的函数。我们对这一数据集依赖性的主张进行了更严格的论证，并证明简单的分离度量指标与语言模型在多种设置下的下游可控性强烈相关，即使在控制了层和数据集效应之后依然如此。除了预测之外，我们通过一个合成叠加实验提供了证据，表明分离度量与经验特征方向和真实特征方向之间的对齐程度强烈相关。我们的结果表明，简单的可分离性统计量可以作为实用的诊断工具，用于判断引导向量何时有效。
tldr: 该论文证明简单的特征分离度量指标与语言模型激活引导的下游可控性强相关，可作为判断引导向量是否有效的实用诊断工具。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that simple separation metrics strongly correlate with the downstream steerability of language models, serving as practical diagnostics for predicting when activation steering will be effective.
